facts.fact: The World Bank's aide-mémoire of its 1-4 December 2025 mission states that the number of communes using the digital civil registration system (SIECM) rose from 75 to 336 over the preceding six months, which it gives as 40% of the project's target and not as a share of all communes; a further 112 communes had been trained but were not yet operational.
facts.system: système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil (SIECM)

facts.fact: The World Bank's aide-mémoire of December 2025 states that 61,892 birth certificates carrying a unique identity number (NIU) had been issued through SIECM in communes; it reports no figure for deaths.
facts.system: système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil (SIECM)

facts.fact: The World Bank's aide-mémoire of December 2025 states that communes themselves use SIECM to register civil-status events and issue birth certificates with a national unique number, and that the system's offline module had only been in demonstration since November 2025; it does not say in terms where the record is held.
facts.system: système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil (SIECM)

facts.fact: The World Bank's aide-mémoire states that communes using SIECM went from 75 to 336 between about June and December 2025, while calling progress on digitising civil registration limited for want of consensus on the software's design, with a migration to SIECM-OpenCRVS imminent and a replacement solution under discussion after OpenCRVS stops.
facts.system: système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil (SIECM)

facts.fact: The World Bank's aide-mémoire of December 2025 reports SIECM's rollout under component 1 of PRODIGY, financed by an IDA credit of US$133 million and a GFF grant of US$3 million and closing on 30 June 2026, and states that the Government was urged to put in place the financial and organisational arrangements for the Centre National de l'État Civil et de l'Identité (CNECI), whose capacity it calls a major constraint.
facts.system: système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil (SIECM)

systems.system: système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil (SIECM)
systems.platform: OpenCRVS (migration to SIECM-OpenCRVS described as imminent; a new solution for scaling under discussion after OpenCRVS stops); offline module in demonstration since November 2025
systems.owner: deployed under the World Bank's PRODIGY project; the Centre National de l'État Civil et de l'Identité (CNECI) is the civil status and identity institution named
systems.tiers: 336 communes using it as at December 2025, 112 more trained and not operational, others not yet equipped

systems.system: numérisation et indexation des actes d'état civil
systems.tiers: 2.9 million civil status acts digitised and 2.77 million indexed in the main districts as at December 2025; extension to the whole country and to marriage and death registers recommended

systems.system: système de gestion de l'identité (IDMS) and biometric enrolment
systems.owner: PRODIGY project unit with the CNECI and the Ministry of the Interior
systems.tiers: proof of concept enrolled about 5,500 people in three districts; pilot in 26 communes planned for end January 2026 and national enrolment from February 2026 with 2,500 kits, later to pass to commune agents; card-printing procurement suspended by the new government
5.09 million households in the national database, booklets distributed in 119 districts, 19.7 million provisional unique identification numbers attributed as at December 2025

systems.system: NIU on birth certificates and links from the civil register
systems.tiers: birth certificates issued through SIECM carry a NIU (61,892 as at December 2025); a pupil census is to attribute a NIU linked to existing birth certificates; digitised acts are to be merged with the biometric database; civil registration data are being prepared for a national performance dashboard

note: The same aide-mémoire as document 41 (the PDF render of the same World Bank file); its facts are identical. The denominator of all communes is not given; the 40% is of the project's target.
